verdict.rationale: Pipecat's production telephony docs describe inbound calls arriving through your own carrier's webhook (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or your SIP provider), and the dev runner targets a carrier directly (`-t twilio`). The site lists SIP and PSTN among supported transports, so you bring your own telephony rather than being locked to a bundled one. Missing for 10: detailed SIP-trunk/PBX configuration documentation and independent or hands-on corroboration of SIP/PBX connectivity.
